theorems.name: ProofAtlas.Projection.above_support_absent
theorems.type: ∀ {e : Expr} {i : Nat}, ProofAtlas.Projection.needed e ≤ i → ¬i ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support e

theorems.name: ProofAtlas.Projection.highest_support_present
theorems.type: ∀ {e : Expr}, 0 < ProofAtlas.Projection.needed e → ProofAtlas.Projection.needed e - 1 ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support e

theorems.name: ProofAtlas.Projection.mem_unbind_iff
theorems.type: ∀ {xs : List Nat} {i : Nat}, i ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.unbind xs ↔ i + 1 ∈ xs

theorems.name: ProofAtlas.Projection.lambda_use_fields
theorems.type:
∀ {n : Name} {t b : Expr} {bi : BinderInfo} {i : Nat},
  i ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support (Expr.lam n t b bi) ↔
    i ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support t ∨ i + 1 ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support b

theorems.name: ProofAtlas.Projection.forall_use_fields
theorems.type:
∀ {n : Name} {t b : Expr} {bi : BinderInfo} {i : Nat},
  i ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support (Expr.forallE n t b bi) ↔
    i ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support t ∨ i + 1 ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support b

theorems.name: ProofAtlas.Projection.let_use_fields
theorems.type:
∀ {n : Name} {t v b : Expr} {nd : Bool} {i : Nat},
  i ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support (Expr.letE n t v b nd) ↔
    (i ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support t ∨ i ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support v) ∨
      i + 1 ∈ ProofAtlas.Projection.support b
